summary: Presidio Spanish NIF and NIE recognizers rejected valid lowercase identifiers because the checksum compared against an uppercase table (ETB-06)
details:
`EsNifRecognizer` and `EsNieRecognizer` in `presidio-analyzer` match candidates without regard to case, then validate them with a mod-23 control letter. The validation compared the extracted letter with an uppercase table and did not change the case of the input. A valid identifier written in lowercase, such as `12345678z` or `x1234567l`, failed validation and was dropped, while the uppercase form was detected. This is ETB-06 (missing normalization): a case variant of the same identifier evaded the detector. The case of the identifier is chosen by whoever writes the text under analysis. Where the recognizer screens the output of a model or agent, that writer is the system being checked. The etb-scan evidence table lists this pull request under ETB-06.

Fix: pull request #2076 (opened 2026-06-18, merged 2026-07-01, first released in presidio-analyzer 2.2.364 on 2026-07-22) upper-cases the candidate text before the checksum. Tests cover valid lowercase identifiers and an invalid checksum that must still be rejected.

database_specific.note: 'introduced: 0' is a conservative bound. Git tag 2.2.363 does not contain the fix commit and tag 2.2.364 does (GitHub compare, 2026-11-12). PyPI lists 2.2.364, uploaded 2026-07-22.

target.name: Presidio Spanish NIF and NIE recognizers

attack.description: Text contains a valid Spanish NIF or NIE written in lowercase. The recognizer matches the candidate, fails the checksum on the lowercase letter, and returns no result.
attack.preconditions: The default Spanish NIF and NIE recognizers. Uppercase identifiers were detected before and after.
attack.poc_pointer: Lowercase cases added to presidio-analyzer/tests/test_es_nif_recognizer.py and test_es_nie_recognizer.py by pull request #2076.

hardening.fix: Upper-case the candidate before the checksum lookup; keep a test that an invalid checksum is still rejected in either case.
hardening.pattern: Normalize both trigger strings and model output before matching (taxonomy ETB-06 fix pattern).
hardening.residual_risk: The fix normalizes case only. Other written variants of the identifier are outside it.

disclosure.tier_reason: Public artifact, no non-public information, impact limited to the detector's result, fix supplied with the report.
disclosure.notes: Reported as pull request #2076 from the AUTHENSOR account, carrying the fix. Approved and merged by a maintainer.

owasp_ai_exchange.status: Proposed by Authensor in OWASP/www-project-ai-security-and-privacy-guide pull request #247, which is open on 2026-11-13. Not published OWASP text.
